Route Panderer and Flatterer into Sirenism.
Preserve Parrhesiast as a distinct category that can overlap Jester.
Expand Baselinemorality through commodification, legitimation or moralization, normalization, and enforcement.

Use Ariel selling her voice as the settled project anchor for the Sellout.
